name: Summit AZ - WP Staging Pages
body:
> Log · Summit Az · 2026-06-18

# Summary
WP-ready HTML bodies, metadata and FAQ JSON staged on 2026-06-18 for two batches of city pages, built from the late May drafts.

# Batch 2 (`meta-batch2.json`)
- New pages: drain cleaning Fountain Hills, water leak detection Scottsdale, water heater services Queen Creek.
- Rebuilt to fix broken canonicals: water heater services Fountain Hills, Gilbert, San Tan Valley (their canonicals pointed at other pages; the 2026-06-23 audit confirmed them self-canonical).
- Each entry: slug, title, focus keyword, SEO title, meta description and 5 FAQs (also in `faqs\*.json`).

# Water softener batch (`water-softener\meta.json`)
- Mesa, Phoenix, Queen Creek, Scottsdale, Tempe installation pages with focus keyword "water softener installation in {city}", SEO title, meta and 5 FAQs each.
